description: This file declares the MessageClient class responsible for managing message buffers, handling message instances, and factories within the WPEFramework Messaging namespace. It includes methods for adding/removing instances, enabling controls, and processing messages, and references external modules like Module.h and MessageUnit.h.

classes.name: MessageClient
classes.description: Class responsible for retrieving data from buffers and sending metadata to buffers, enabling categories, and managing message instances and factories.

methods.name: MessageClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MessageClient with an identifier, base path, and optional socket port.

methods.name: AddInstance
methods.description: Adds a message instance with the specified ID.

methods.name: RemoveInstance
methods.description: Removes a message instance with the specified ID.

methods.name: WaitForUpdates
methods.description: Waits for updates for a specified amount of time.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Retrieves control information into the provided iterator.

methods.name: PopMessagesAndCall
methods.description: Processes messages and calls the provided handler.

methods.name: AddFactory
methods.description: Adds a factory for a specific message type.

methods.name: RemoveFactory
methods.description: Removes a factory for a specific message type.
